marketSummary: Indian equities are facing intense selling pressure as benchmark Nifty 50 slips below key support levels around 22,500, triggered by relentless foreign institutional investor (FII) outflows exceeding ₹20,100 crore over the last two trading sessions. A sharp spike in the US 10-year Treasury yield toward 5.3% alongside elevated crude oil prices has dampened risk appetite across high-beta and mid-cap spaces, though IT counters are displaying defensive relative strength.
dailyFocus: Prioritize high relative-strength leaders with clear institutional accumulation or fundamental catalysts (order wins/upgrades) while strictly avoiding wide-range breakdown setups amidst aggressive FII liquidation.

news.headline: FII Selling Intensifies with Over ₹20,100 Crore Pulled Out in Two Sessions as Nifty Breaks 22,500 Support
news.summary: Foreign institutional investors accelerated cash equity sales, offloading ₹10,148.41 crore on September 30 following similar outflows earlier in the week, driven by US 10-year yields surging to 5.3% and geopolitical crude volatility. The selloff drove benchmark Nifty below 22,500 in early October trade.
news.impact: Indicates high odds of failure for unconfirmed breakout patterns; swing traders should tighten stops and reduce overnight beta exposure.

news.headline: BofA Securities Initiates Coverage on Trent with 'Buy' After Zudio Surpasses 1,000-Store Milestone
news.summary: Bank of America initiated research coverage on Tata Group retailer Trent with a 'Buy' rating and 17% potential upside, highlighting scalable compounding in Zudio after the value-fashion format crossed 1,000 stores across 300 Indian cities. The company has also closed its trading window ahead of upcoming Q2 FY27 results.
news.impact: Validates medium-term institutional demand, but heavy broad market drag means swing entries require a clear consolidation handle above ₹2,600 support.

news.headline: Jefferies Retains 'Buy' with ₹6,800 Target Citing Fast-Approaching Tejas Mk1A Deliveries
news.summary: Jefferies reaffirmed its positive view on Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd, highlighting that Tejas Mk1A deliveries represent 43% of the company's order book and act as a major re-rating trigger. HAL CMD Ravi Kota confirmed confidence in handing over 10 aircraft this fiscal year, beating earlier brokerage assumptions of 5.
news.impact: Supports strong structural base consolidation near ₹4,650-₹4,700, positioning the stock for an eventual multi-week base breakout on delivery confirmation.

news.headline: Avalon Technologies Witnesses ₹883 Crore Block Deal; Promoters Sell 6.06% Equity
news.summary: Around 40.5 lakh shares (6.06% equity) of Avalon Technologies changed hands on September 30 in an ₹883 crore block deal at an average price of ₹2,181 per share. Promoter entities were the primary sellers, with institutional domestic funds including Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund absorbing substantial shares.
news.impact: Creates immediate supply overhang around ₹2,180-₹2,230; look for price stabilization above the block level before considering any flag or base breakout continuation.

news.headline: Power Mech Projects Secures ₹549.37 Crore 5-Year O&M Contract from Moxie Power
news.summary: Power Mech Projects announced securing an operation and maintenance (O&M) order valued at ₹549.37 crore from Adani Group entity Moxie Power Generation. The contract tenure spans 60 months from October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2031, providing sustained multi-year revenue visibility.
news.impact: Serves as an immediate fundamental catalyst that can trigger an upside volume surge out of its recent multi-week consolidation band.

news.headline: BSE Ltd Enters Nifty 50 Replacing Wipro, Triggering Over ₹6,000 Crore in Passive Inflows
news.summary: BSE Ltd formally completed its inclusion into the benchmark Nifty 50 index effective September 30, replacing IT major Wipro. The semi-annual adjustment triggered massive trading volumes and estimated passive fund allocation flows of roughly ₹6,000 crore.
news.impact: Watch for post-inclusion volume dry-up or retest of base support as passive rebalancing liquidity settles over the next few sessions.

news.headline: Persistent Systems Concludes Strategic Investor Sessions Regarding Nagarro Agreement
news.summary: Persistent Systems submitted exchange filings under Regulation 30 regarding investor briefings held on September 30 detailing the Business Combination Agreement entered with Nagarro SE. Management highlighted synergy potential across cloud infrastructure and digital engineering capabilities.
news.impact: Demonstrates relative resilience among mid-tier IT names; watch for breakout continuation if consolidation above its 50-DMA holds on above-average volumes.

news.headline: CG Power Realignment in Focus Post Management Shift and High-Value NSE Block Deal
news.summary: CG Power disclosed key managerial changes under Regulation 30 on September 30 alongside an institutional block trade on NSE of ~2.18 lakh shares at ₹841.95. Management recently completed institutional interactions organized by Macquarie and IIFL focusing on the CG Semi OSAT timeline and transformer capex ramp-up.
news.impact: The stock is testing lower boundaries of its ₹840-₹900 range; requires strong price action confirmation before trading any swing setup.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Consolidates Around ₹1,290 Following OFS Absorption and Dividend Record Date
news.summary: Shares of Cochin Shipyard are testing support near ₹1,290 after recent corporate actions including dividend adjustment and market absorption of the government's 5% OFS. The company continues execution on major naval and commercial vessel build orders.
news.impact: Look for a clear base stabilization and contraction in daily selling volumes near ₹1,250-₹1,280 before considering fresh swing accumulation.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Continues Order Inflow Momentum with Cumulative ₹648 Crore Win
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited continues to build out its ₹74,000+ crore backlog with additional contract tranches totaling ₹648 crore, covering laser-based IR jammers, communication systems, and AI-enabled software solutions. The inflow reinforces steady execution tailwinds following recent mega DAC approvals.
news.impact: Provides downside price support during broad index pullbacks, keeping the broader multi-month ascending channel intact.

news.headline: Vadilal Industries Executes 12-Month Bridge Supply Agreement with Vadilal Enterprises
news.summary: Vadilal Industries entered into a revised 12-month domestic supply pact with Vadilal Enterprises on September 30, averting an immediate distribution stoppage after the previous 10-year pact expired and public shareholders pushed back against long-term renewal terms.
news.impact: Eliminates immediate operational shutdown risk, but the short 1-year bridge agreement leaves corporate governance overhang that limits sustained upside breakout potential.
